$comment: Machine-readable definition of done. Only flip passes to true with evidence (a command that ran, an artifact that exists). Workers never edit verify commands or acceptance criteria — that's a spec change, report it.

features.title: CI gate + TypeScript/Tailwind scaffold
features.acceptance: npm run ci (typecheck + build) passes on a fresh clone; old src/ removed; new app boots with vite dev.
features.evidence: VERIFIED 2026-07-26: `npm run ci` (tsc --noEmit && vite build) exit 0; old src/*.jsx and committed dist/ removed from git; new TS entry src/main.tsx builds (dist/assets/index-B0Ccyi3T.js).

features.title: Design system & visual identity
features.acceptance: Design tokens (color, type ramp, spacing scale, radius ladder) defined once and used by all components; passes uxpeak rubric self-score with 0 blocker fails; dark music-forward identity distinct from old Bandcamp-clone look.

features.title: App shell: responsive nav + routing
features.acceptance: Desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav (44px targets), real routes for home/library/editorial/publish/profile/release detail, 404 handled, works at 375px and 1440px widths.

features.title: Home feed (releases + editorial)
features.acceptance: Home fetches /registry, renders release and editorial cards with skeleton loading and designed empty states; source banner (api/file/sample) preserved.

features.title: Release detail + persistent audio player
features.acceptance: Release page with cover/metadata/tags; global player bar persists across routes, play/pause/seek works with audioUri, keyboard accessible.

features.title: Library with working search/sort/filter
features.acceptance: Virtualized grid (react-window) handles 500+ items; text search, sort (date/title/artist/price) and type filter actually filter results; global top-bar search wired to it.

features.title: Editorial reading view
features.acceptance: Editorial list + article page with proper reading typography (body 140-170% line-height).

features.title: Phantom wallet auth + profile
features.acceptance: Connect/disconnect Phantom (signature login as upstream), session persisted, profile page shows user's releases; graceful no-wallet fallback with install hint.

features.title: Publish flow
features.acceptance: Multi-step publish modal/page: metadata form (validated), cover + audio via chunk upload or TX-ID paste, POST /manifest, success/error/timeout states incl. mock modes (?mock=ok|writefail|400|timeout).

features.title: Favorites & history persisted
features.acceptance: Favorites and listening history survive reload (localStorage), surfaced on their own pages.

features.title: Backend: durable registry + seed
features.acceptance: GET /registry returns seeded demo catalog on the preview deployment (not []); manifest pointer survives cold starts (durable store or REGISTRY_MANIFEST env fallback documented); write path validated with Zod as before.
features.verify: curl -s $PREVIEW_URL/registry | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d)>0'

features.title: Repo hygiene
features.acceptance: dist/, *.swo, validator logs, test-ledger removed from git; .gitignore covers them; README quickstart corrected (real clone URL, real branch).

features.title: Preview deployment
features.acceptance: Fork deploys on Vercel; preview URL shared with user; frontend + api/ function both work there.
